title: say — Spanish

phrases.translation: 为自己找借口，为自己辩护
vt. 同意（允诺，承认）；说对

sentences.sentence: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
sentences.translation: “我太累了。”她说。

sentences.sentence: ‘Don’t cry,’ he said softly.
sentences.translation: “别哭了。”他柔声说道。

sentences.sentence: Don’t believe anything he says.
sentences.translation: 他说什么都不要相信。

sentences.sentence: I always said I would buy a motorbike when I had enough money.
sentences.translation: 我一直说等我有了足够的钱就买一辆摩托车。

sentences.sentence: I would like to say how much we appreciate your hard work.
sentences.translation: 我想说我们对你的辛勤劳动非常感谢。

sentences.sentence: ‘Why did she leave?’ ‘I don’t know – she didn’t say .’
sentences.translation: “她为什么要离开？”“我不知道——她没说。”

sentences.sentence: Although he didn’t say so , it was clear that he was in pain.
sentences.translation: 虽然他没说，但是他明显很痛苦。

sentences.sentence: (= why do you think that ) ?
sentences.translation: 你怎么会那么说呢？

sentences.sentence: I’d like to say a few words (= make a short speech ) .
sentences.translation: 我想简单地说几句。

sentences.sentence: ‘So what are your plans now?’‘ I’d rather not say .’
sentences.translation: “那么你现在的计划是什么？”“我还是不说的好。”

sentences.sentence: She was greatly tempted to have a look at it.
sentences.translation: 她非常想看一看。

sentences.sentence: Today we’ll have a look at a hadron collider of the Nuclear Physics Institute in Novosibirsk.
sentences.translation: 今天让我们来看一看位于新西伯利亚市核物理研究所的强子对撞机。

sentences.sentence: The children really believed that there was a rabbit on the moon. They wanted to go to the moon and have a look one day.
sentences.translation: 这个时候；一些老人会讲述许多古老的故事，如月亮上的玉兔，孩子们信以为真，他们真想有一天登上月球看个究竟。

sentences.sentence: No, I do not like sushi.
sentences.translation: 不，我不喜欢寿司。

sentences.sentence: Do you like sushi?
sentences.translation: 你喜欢寿司吗？

sentences.sentence: I want sushi.
sentences.translation: 我想要寿司。

sentences.sentence: She volunteered to teach in the school.
sentences.translation: 她自愿在学校教书。

sentences.sentence: If someone puts you down,you should teach him a lesson.
sentences.translation: 如果有人奚落你，你就应该教训教训他。

phrases.translation: 千真万确地；和…一样肯定无疑

sentences.sentence: ‘Can you pick me up later?’ ‘Sure thing.’
sentences.translation: “你过一会儿能来接我吗？”“没问题。”

sentences.sentence: What about the Canadian policy?
sentences.translation: 那么加拿大的政策呢？

sentences.sentence: The fugitive is believed to be headed for the Canadian border.
sentences.translation: 据信，逃亡者正向加拿大边界方向逃窜。

sentences.sentence: Most English people bracket American and Canadian accents together.
sentences.translation: 大多数英国人都把美国音和加拿大音相提并论。

sentences.sentence: First-year students may elect  French, Spanish, or German.
sentences.translation: 一年级学生可选修法语、西班牙语或德语。

sentences.sentence: The English and the Spanish were among the first to colonize North America.
sentences.translation: 英国人和西班牙人是首先向北美洲开拓殖民地的。

sentences.sentence: At his lordship's death in the Spanish campaign in the year 1811,his estate fell in to the family of the Tiptoffs.
sentences.translation: 这位爵爷在1811年西班牙战役中死亡后，他的产业归蒂普托夫家族支配。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教小学五年级 · 第 15 单元

say
音标：英 /seɪ/  美 /se/
说；讲
短语：say to oneself — 心里想；自言自语
短语：that is to say — 就是；即；换言之
短语：they say — 据说；人们说
短语：say when — [俚语]停止；制止
短语：say goodbye — 说再见；告别
短语：say for oneself — 为自己找借口，为自己辩护
短语：say yes — vt. 同意（允诺，承认）；说对
短语：say about — 说到
短语：how to say — 怎么说
短语：say nothing — 什么也不说
短语：say hello — 打招呼；问好
短语：what i say — 我说什么
短语：nothing to say — 无话可说
短语：say on — v. 说下去
短语：say well — 说得对，说得好
短语：hard to say — 很难说
短语：say sorry to — 对……说对不起
短语：as you say — 就像你说的
短语：let us say — 比如说；假定；假如说
短语：so to say — 可以这么说
例句：‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
“我太累了。”她说。
例句：‘Don’t cry,’ he said softly.
“别哭了。”他柔声说道。
例句：Don’t believe anything he says.
他说什么都不要相信。
例句：I always said I would buy a motorbike when I had enough money.
我一直说等我有了足够的钱就买一辆摩托车。
例句：I would like to say how much we appreciate your hard work.
我想说我们对你的辛勤劳动非常感谢。
例句：‘Why did she leave?’ ‘I don’t know – she didn’t say .’
“她为什么要离开？”“我不知道——她没说。”
例句：Although he didn’t say so , it was clear that he was in pain.
虽然他没说，但是他明显很痛苦。
例句：(= why do you think that ) ?
你怎么会那么说呢？
例句：I’d like to say a few words (= make a short speech ) .
我想简单地说几句。
例句：‘So what are your plans now?’‘ I’d rather not say .’
“那么你现在的计划是什么？”“我还是不说的好。”

have a look
看一看
例句：She was greatly tempted to have a look at it.
她非常想看一看。
例句：Today we’ll have a look at a hadron collider of the Nuclear Physics Institute in Novosibirsk.
今天让我们来看一看位于新西伯利亚市核物理研究所的强子对撞机。
例句：The children really believed that there was a rabbit on the moon. They wanted to go to the moon and have a look one day.
这个时候；一些老人会讲述许多古老的故事，如月亮上的玉兔，孩子们信以为真，他们真想有一天登上月球看个究竟。

sushi
音标：英 /'suːʃɪ/  美 /'sʊʃi/
寿司
例句：No, I do not like sushi.
不，我不喜欢寿司。
例句：Do you like sushi?
你喜欢寿司吗？
例句：I want sushi.
我想要寿司。

teach
音标：英 /tiːtʃ/  美 /titʃ/
教
短语：teach oneself — 自学
短语：teach english — 教英语
短语：teach school — 教书；当教师
例句：She volunteered to teach in the school.
她自愿在学校教书。
例句：If someone puts you down,you should teach him a lesson.
如果有人奚落你，你就应该教训教训他。

sure
音标：英 /ʃɔ:(r)/  美 /ʃʊər; ʃʊr/
当然
短语：make sure — 确信；证实
短语：for sure — adv. 确实；毫无疑问地
短语：sure of — 确信…的
短语：sure enough — 果然，果真
短语：are you sure — 你肯定吗；你确定要…
短语：sure about — 肯定；对…确信的
短语：not so sure — 不太确定
短语：as sure as — 千真万确地；和…一样肯定无疑
短语：be sure of oneself — v. 自信；有自信心
短语：make sure of — 确定；确保；尽力做到
短语：pretty sure — 相当肯定
短语：that's for sure — 那是肯定的
短语：be sure to do — 一定做某事；确定做
例句：‘Can you pick me up later?’ ‘Sure thing.’
“你过一会儿能来接我吗？”“没问题。”

Canadian
音标：英 /kə'neɪdɪən/  美 /kə'nedɪən/
加拿大的
短语：canadian english — 加拿大英语
短语：canadian shield — 加拿大地盾
短语：french canadian — n. 法裔加拿大人
例句：What about the Canadian policy?
那么加拿大的政策呢？
例句：The fugitive is believed to be headed for the Canadian border.
据信，逃亡者正向加拿大边界方向逃窜。
例句：Most English people bracket American and Canadian accents together.
大多数英国人都把美国音和加拿大音相提并论。

Spanish
音标：英 /'spænɪʃ/  美 /'spænɪʃ/
西班牙的
短语：spanish mackerel — n. 马加鱼
短语：spanish flu — 西班牙流感（等于Spanish influenza）
短语：spanish civil war — [历史]西班牙内战（1936-1939）
短语：spanish armada — 无敌舰队
短语：spanish moss — 铁兰
例句：First-year students may elect  French, Spanish, or German.
一年级学生可选修法语、西班牙语或德语。
例句：The English and the Spanish were among the first to colonize North America.
英国人和西班牙人是首先向北美洲开拓殖民地的。
例句：At his lordship's death in the Spanish campaign in the year 1811,his estate fell in to the family of the Tiptoffs.
这位爵爷在1811年西班牙战役中死亡后，他的产业归蒂普托夫家族支配。
